IMF Warns of Widening Budget Deficits in Major Economies

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has warned that major economies are on track to experience their largest budget deficits since the COVID-19 pandemic. Concurrently, the European Union has cautioned against significant reductions to the bloc's budget.
